notes: Every pin in the runtime, with its reason (spec §1.3). This file's SHA-256 is hashed into every eval record the package produces, so any result can be traced to the exact stack that produced it. slice1_status: 'installed' = present in the slice-1 runtime venv; 'declared' = pin recorded now, installed with the component that consumes it (train pack / USD bridge) in a later build slice — never silently treated as present. Slice 2 (2026-11-17): train pack installed and proven (round-trip + local FL round); pins above marked installed are verified present at the recorded versions by doctor check 2.

pins.name: python
pins.reason: LeRobot 0.7.0's installed base in all certified zk0 work is Python 3.12; the runtime carries its own interpreter and borrows nothing from the system Python (spec §1.2/§1.3).

pins.name: mujoco
pins.reason: Certified Stack A physics engine (final scorecard winner, SSOT decisions 21–23); every certified sim result in the program was produced on 4.0.1.

pins.name: numpy
pins.reason: The version in the certified sim environment on the DGX Spark (BAM-tier / rung-3 venvs) that produced the certified harness results.

pins.name: lerobot
pins.reason: The version the repaired shared checkpoint (ivelin/zk0-smolvla-fl) loads under, and the version all certified sim work used (spec §1.3).

pins.name: pyav
pins.reason: PyAV 19 breaks LeRobot 0.7.0 dataset capture (desc-scenes finding, SSOT decision 26). The resolver must never pick 19.x. Installed: 15.1.0, the latest 15.x — inside LeRobot 0.7.0's own av extra requirement (av>=15,<16, read from the installed lerobot METADATA). Capture proven by the train-pack round-trip (zk0 trainpack prove).

pins.name: datasets
pins.reason: LeRobot 0.7.0 does not pin datasets exactly; its installed METADATA (dataset extra) requires datasets>=4.8.0,<6.0.0. 5.1.0 is the version LeRobot 0.7.0 was released against: 5.1.0 (2026-10-05) was the newest release inside that range on LeRobot 0.7.0's release day (2026-11-05; 5.2.0 followed on 2026-11-09), and it is the version in the certified checkpoint environment. Chosen on that evidence (slice 2), not invented.

pins.name: newton
pins.reason: Certified OpenUSD→MuJoCo bridge of Stack A (SSOT decisions 21–23); consumed by the USD asset path, not by the MJCF sim loop.

pins.name: flwr
pins.reason: Inherited from the zk0 repo's existing pin (pyproject.toml) — the framework zk0's published FL record runs on; no Flower major-version migration is part of v0.1 (spec §1.3). INSTALL NOTE (slice 2, a documented constraint override): flwr 1.23.0 requires click<8.2, while every huggingface-hub in LeRobot 0.7.0's required range (>=1.31,<3.0) requires click>=8.4.2 — jointly unsatisfiable in one environment. flwr is therefore installed --no-deps after its non-click dependencies, and the runtime carries click 8.5.1. `pip check` reports exactly three known conflicts, all flwr's own requirements against the versions the runtime carries: click<8.2 (carried: 8.5.1), iterators<0.0.3,>=0.0.2 (carried: 0.2.0 — flwr's non-click dependencies install at their current releases, outside flwr's pinned ranges), and pathspec<0.13.0,>=0.12.1 (carried: 1.1.1); the package does not claim a clean resolve — flwr's server/client are instead exercised by the local-round proof. The [simulation,superexec] extras are not installed: the local network uses core server/client.
